extracted.intended_audience: Authors and writers (new and established) seeking to promote books on TikTok/BookTok
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guide for authors to set up an author/business TikTok account, create platform-specific content, grow an audience, and convert BookTok engagement into book sales. Covers profile setup, content types, posting strategy, collaborations, SEO, and promotional tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a TikTok Business account & author profile
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a TikTok Business account and build an author profile (switch account type, choose category like Author/Writer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step: Download app → Sign up → Profile → Settings & Privacy → Account → Switch to Business Account; explore Creator tools, enable Live Q&A, duets. Link Instagram and other external links. Use analytics and scheduling features available to business/creator accounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pick a clear genre and target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Pick a clear genre and audience, then follow trends, hashtags, and creators to understand your readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide your genre (e.g., romance, fantasy, YA) before writing bio/username; research BookTok trends in your niche; use TikTok demographics (e.g., 18–24) and analytics to refine audience; test & iterate content based on audience reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Username and bio that communicate brand
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a username and TikTok bio that reflect your author persona and genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make username catchy, easy to remember and genre-related (example: chellewritesromance). Bio can mention genre or tell a short story; sprinkle personality and trending keywords to pique interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use a personal, human profile picture
rubrics_metrics.description: Use your own face or a personal image rather than an impersonal book cover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BookTok is visual and human-centered—show the real you (e.g., posing with a mug). A face helps authenticity and connection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add relevant external links
rubrics_metrics.description: Include links to your website, book page, or purchase platform in your profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make it easy for viewers to find and buy your books; include book pages, author website, or a Linktree-style hub.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post consistently (frequency guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Post regularly to stay visible; recommended starting cadence is 3–4 videos per week.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TikTok rewards consistency. Even short, low-effort videos (quotes, day-in-the-life) help keep account active. Test cadence and iterate based on analytics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hook viewers quickly (first 2–3 seconds)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hook viewers in the first 2–3 seconds with a question, bold statement, or strong visual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attention is brief on TikTok—start with an attention-grabbing opener to increase watch-through and engagement, which boosts distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimal video length guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep most videos under 60 seconds; for longer storytelling, use up to 3 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short videos are easier to consume and share; reserve longer formats for chapter recaps or extended storytelling where warranted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use trending sounds and challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Use trending audio and hashtags to boost visibility and get videos into the For You feed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participate in trends but add your own authentic twist. Use TikTok’s Discover page to stay updated. Incorporate book elements into trends (e.g., adapt a dance to represent a character trait).

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep authenticity when leveraging trends
rubrics_metrics.description: Create authentic content when using trending challenges—don’t fully replicate others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add your personality so viewers feel a connection to your brand; avoid feeling like a scripted ad. Authenticity often performs better than perfect polish.

rubrics_metrics.name: TikTok SEO: keyword research & captions
rubrics_metrics.description: Add TikTok SEO keywords in captions and hashtags using keyword research and TikTok’s search suggestions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use tools (Google Ads Planner, Ahrefs, SEMrush) and TikTok search bar to find phrases your audience uses. Avoid keyword stuffing; focus on creating content that prompts engagement (comments/likes) which helps discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage hashtags to signal genre and increase discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: Use relevant hashtags like #BookTok, #YAfiction, or genre-specific tags to reach the right audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine broad BookTok hashtags with niche/genre hashtags. Consider creating a unique contest hashtag for giveaways or challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage with readers and creators (duets, stitches, Q&As, comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Actively interact via duets, stitches, Q&As, comments, and by responding to viewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagement builds community and signals relevance to the algorithm. Use creator features (duets/stitches) to tap into other audiences and foster conversation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create diverse content types: book-specific
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce book-specific content (sneak peeks, teasers, behind-the-scenes, character & world-building, answer reader questions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use humor, skits, monologues, or voice filters for character reveals; show research or messy desk for process; host Q&As to keep suspense balanced and answer reader curiosity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create diverse content types: general literary
rubrics_metrics.description: Share book recommendations and reviews, writing tips, trope debates, and relatable author experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all content should be promotional—build authority and community by discussing other books and providing value (tips, insights). This attracts followers who trust your taste.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create interactive/community-driven content
rubrics_metrics.description: Use duets/stitches, polls, Q&A sessions, hosting writing challenges and book clubs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host challenges (e.g., write a 500‑word complete story) and book clubs to encourage user-generated content and sustained engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce visual book trailers and cover reveals
rubrics_metrics.description: Make visual book trailers and cover reveals using TikTok’s editing tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep theme consistent and focus on quality—use high-quality images, engaging graphics, consistent color palette, and music that sets mood. Build suspense with countdowns and interactive events; encourage viewers to comment/guess plot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover reveal & trailer tips (narrative, music, suspense)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set a narrative, incorporate trending music/effects, create suspense for reveals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use music that matches your book’s theme; create a narrative arc or tease plot/characters; use countdowns and encourage interaction to maximize buzz.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner with other BookTok authors for cross-promotion
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborate with authors in your niche to host lives, share processes, hold joint giveaways, reading challenges, or contests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaborate only with authors who share a similar target audience to avoid wasted exposure. Joint live sessions and cross-promotion introduce you to relevant followers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage BookTok influencers strategically
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborate with influencers (reviews, features) but prioritize engagement rate and authenticity over raw follower count.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify influencers who post in your genre; check engagement metrics; reach out via their preferred contact (bio message/email); offer value (free copies, exclusive access, payment); allow honest reviews rather than scripted promotions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run giveaways/contests with clear rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Host giveaways or contests to incentivize engagement; clearly state rules, how winners are chosen, and the contest end date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote across platforms, use trending music/hashtags, actively engage with participants, and post follow-up videos announcing winners or showcasing prize delivery. Choose prizes that appeal to your target audience (signed copies or genre-relevant books).

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure and monitor collaboration effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully monitor engagement and reach of influencer and author collaborations to determine effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track metrics provided by Creator tools/analytics to learn which partnerships drove traffic, sales, or followers. Use results to refine future campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer value-driven influencer collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: When approaching influencers, offer value-driven collaborations (free book, exclusive content, or compensation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don’t try to sway their opinion—authentic reviews are more impactful. Negotiate deliverables and measure outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage audience interaction & calls-to-action
rubrics_metrics.description: Ask viewers to comment, like, guess plot points, or participate in challenges—CTAs increase engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit CTAs increase comments and shares which improve discoverability; respond to comments to sustain engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Creator tools & analytics to refine strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage built-in TikTok analytics and Creator tools to understand demographics, engagement patterns, and video performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use insights to optimize posting times, content types, and topics. Schedule videos and enable Live features where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gear and production basics
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic gear is sufficient: smartphone, natural light, ring light, and TikTok’s built-in editing tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You don’t need a studio—good lighting and clear audio matter. Use TikTok editing features to add text overlays, transitions, and captions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monetization beyond book sales
rubrics_metrics.description: Monetize via affiliate links, selling courses/templates, coaching, or joining TikTok’s Creator Fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creator Fund is not a major revenue stream for many; diversify income with products/services aligned with your author brand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderate negative comments professionally
rubrics_metrics.description: Handle negative or trolling comments by staying professional—ignore, block, or politely respond if constructive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use comment filters and moderation tools to maintain a positive environment and protect community focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain consistent visual theme & brand quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep a consistent theme (color palette, visuals) and focus on quality across videos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistency helps recognition and strengthens your brand; visual coherence between cover, trailers, and profile reinforces identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create your own challenges to drive UGC
rubrics_metrics.description: Create challenges related to your book’s theme to encourage user-generated content (UGC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UGC spreads reach organically; provide clear instructions and a unique hashtag to track participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate BookTok account for focused branding
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a dedicated TikTok account for book/author content rather than mixing with unrelated content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A focused account helps you build a targeted audience and maintain brand consistency.
